title: Persist goal in session metadata
objective: Add Goal to SessionMeta and preserve it through metadata merge operations.
context: This is the minimal Codex-like durability layer for /goal.
The change must not disturb existing Usage, Presentation, Decision, Evidence, or SeenToolUseIDs handling.

source_evidence.note: SaveMeta is the key merge point.

include: Clone or copy Goal safely during SaveMeta merge.
Keep nil or zero Goal omitted from JSON.

implementation_steps: Add a Goal field to SessionMeta with json omitempty.
Update SaveMeta merge to preserve and replace Goal only when provided.
Add a clone helper if Goal contains maps or slices.
risks: Import cycle if goal package imports session later.
dispatch_prompt: Implement SessionMeta Goal persistence and SaveMeta merge behavior to satisfy session/goal_meta_test.go. Keep changes local to session/session.go unless a tiny helper file is necessary.
notes_for_assignee: If a direct import of goal causes a cycle, introduce a session-local DTO and document the conversion point.
